leah_csm: Heads up  Ember alpha enrollments stalled at 5/20. Two accounts flagged as renewal risk. Thinking: quick activation sprint (in-product tour + office hours) + small usage credit to jumpstart adoption. Thoughts?

noah_se: I can do a 25m hands-on lab focusing on embeddings -> rerank. Prefer pre-seeded repo so customers hit results in 10m.

rachel_pm: Ill draft a 4-slide product highlight + checklist. Also propose a 3-question post-session pulse (WAU, blocker, renewal likelihood).

sam_enable: We should run sessions at 09:00 PT and 18:00 CET for EMEA. I can handle invites and the in-product walkthrough notes.

financebot: approval request created: ember-credit-tier-1 (amount $150) pending finance review. link: https://fin.redwood.com/req/4821

leah_csm: Good. Noah  can you add a tiny node snippet that creates embeddings and calls rerank? Keep it under 20 lines.

noah_se: Yep — will push snippet + short README to the shared drive by EOD.

rachel_pm: I'll add UTM parameters for email variants to measure which subject drives signups. Two subject ideas: "Quick lab: embed+rerank in 10m" vs "Improve search relevance quickly".

sam_enable: Also will prepare a short playbook for admins to reduce friction (API key setup, sample dataset, common errors). Need copy review by tomorrow AM.

leah_csm: Action recap: Noah - lab repo + snippet (EOD). Rachel - slides + pulse form + email variants (tomorrow AM). Sam - invites + in-product tour + admin playbook (tomorrow AM). I'll follow up with finance on the credit approval and tag the two at-risk accounts. Reconvene Fri 10am PT to decide next steps based on signups.

rachel_pm: :thumbsup:

financebot: approval submitted to finance for ember-credit-tier-1; notify leah_csm when approved.
